title: DRONE-BASED LAND SURVEYS AND DIGITISATION OF PROPERTY RECORDS
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Panchayati Raj

DRONE-BASED LAND SURVEYS AND DIGITISATION OF PROPERTY RECORDS

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
21 JUL 2026 6:20PM by PIB Delhi

The main objective of the SVAMITVA Scheme is to provide Record of Rights to property owners in rural inhabited areas. Under the Scheme, rural inhabited land is demarcated using drone survey and Continuously Operating Reference Stations (CORS) technology to create high accuracy maps of abadi areas of villages. These highly accurate maps help reduce property-related disputes by clearly demarcating property boundaries and creating Record of Rights. The Scheme provides for ground verification and resolution of objections/disputes by the competent State authorities before issuance of Property Cards, ensuring transparency and fair demarcation of properties.

The Ministry of Panchayati Raj has conducted an impact evaluation of the Scheme through IIM Ahmedabad to assess the impact on bank loan uptake and Gram Panchayat’s own sources of revenue. The study found substantial increase in bank loan amounts availed against property cards and increase in Gram Panchayat’s property tax and other local taxes after implementation of SVAMITVA Scheme. The Ministry does not maintain data on the number of land disputes resolved before and after implementation of the Scheme. As on date, drone survey has been completed in 3.30 lakh villages, and 3.24 crore Property Cards have been prepared for 1.97 lakh villages.

DRONE-BASED LAND SURVEYS AND DIGITISATION OF PROPERTY RECORDS

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
21 JUL 2026 6:20PM by PIB Delhi

The main objective of the SVAMITVA Scheme is to provide Record of Rights to property owners in rural inhabited areas. Under the Scheme, rural inhabited land is demarcated using drone survey and Continuously Operating Reference Stations (CORS) technology to create high accuracy maps of abadi areas of villages. These highly accurate maps help reduce property-related disputes by clearly demarcating property boundaries and creating Record of Rights. The Scheme provides for ground verification and resolution of objections/disputes by the competent State authorities before issuance of Property Cards, ensuring transparency and fair demarcation of properties.

The Ministry of Panchayati Raj has conducted an impact evaluation of the Scheme through IIM Ahmedabad to assess the impact on bank loan uptake and Gram Panchayat’s own sources of revenue. The study found substantial increase in bank loan amounts availed against property cards and increase in Gram Panchayat’s property tax and other local taxes after implementation of SVAMITVA Scheme. The Ministry does not maintain data on the number of land disputes resolved before and after implementation of the Scheme. As on date, drone survey has been completed in 3.30 lakh villages, and 3.24 crore Property Cards have been prepared for 1.97 lakh villages.
